headline: Hand-poured Vermont soy wax in zero waste packaging
body: Pure natural soy wax poured by hand in Vermont. No synthetic fragrances and completely plastic-free packaging for a clean home fragrance.
rationale: This persona demands concrete environmental details and transparent sourcing while strongly rejecting greenwashing. The copy names the exact wax, the lack of synthetic additives, and the Vermont origin, directly matching their demand for specific sustainability claims without relying on vague eco buzzwords.
